result.reason: The operative language covers Affiliates and contractors acting on Company's behalf, makes the royalty-free perpetual licence irrevocable, and permits transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction. It therefore reaches the fallback transfer position while satisfying the preferred scope protections. Unrelated commercial intent is preserved. However, adding “worldwide” is not required by the playbook, so the redline is not strictly minimal. Drafting is otherwise professional, though the transfer language could be integrated more cleanly into the licence grant.
